newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Gulf approves Apollo investment.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Gulf approves Apollo investment.

text.p: Atlantic Gulf Communities Corp said on Wednesday that its shareholders approved a major investment from Apollo Real Estate Advisors LP.
The approvals for the issuance of more than 5 million shares came at the company's annual meeting which was held on June 23 in Miami, Atlantic Gulf said in a statement.

A series of stock, warrant and convertible preferred share offerings will increase the number of shares outstanding to 15 million and Apollo will be the largest shareholder of Atlantic Gulf, a company spokesman said.
The Atlantic Gulf spokesman said a series of deals will raise $55 million in new equity, if fully subscribed. Proceeds will be used for new projects, the spokesman said.
Apollo will invest up to $25 million in new shares of Series A 20 percent redeemable cumulative convertible preferred stock of Atlantic Gulf and warrants to buy five million shares of Atlantic Gulf.
Apollo will have the opportunity to co-invest with the company up to an additional $60 million in new joint ventures.

Atlantic Gulf stockholders also approved the private placement of $10 million of new Series B 20 percent redeemable cumulative convertible preferred stock, $10 million Atlantic Gulf common stock at market price, and 2 million warrants to purchase additional common stock. The company reported that this private placement has closed and funded.

Stockholders also approved a rights offering of an additional $10 million of Series B Preferred Stock and warrants to purchase 2 million shares of the company's common stock to shareholders of record as of June 20, 1997.
The Series A and B preferred stock, including any accrued dividends, would be convertible into Atlantic Gulf common stock at $5.75 per share.
